content: Jetro, Moisésʼse atakapid

Jetro Moisés-e-saka, Madiánʼgi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goledga maid. We-Jetroʼde, igi Bab-Dummad Moisés-bendaksa, bela wisgusad. Degine, igi Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemar-bendaksabali, bela wisgusbalid. Deginbali, wisgusbalid, igi Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar Egipto-yargi onosbali.
Moisés Faraónʼse-nadapidgi, e-saka-Jetroʼse e-ome-Séfora barmisgusad. Jetro na e-sisgwa-Séfora e-neggi abingasad,
degine, Moisés-masmala-warbogwad abingasbalid. Wargwen Gersónʼye nugad, ar ade, Moisés sogsa gusad: “We-yar-baidgi an we-yarginedsulid gudiiye.”
Baid-machigwadi, Eliezerʼye nugad, ar ade, Moisés sogsa gusbalid: “An-bab-e-Bab-Dummad an-bendaknonikid, Faraón-es-suidgi an-onosad.”
Moisés nega-dulesulidganba Bab-Dummad-yar-walik dulemar-oambikudapid. Ase, Jetro, Moisés-e-ome, degi, e-masmala-warbogwad nade gusmalad.
Jetro, Moisés-owisos gusad: “Ani, an be-sak-Jetro, be-ome, degi, be-masmala-warbogwadmala, anmar be-dakdanimalad.”
Moisés e-saka-abin noar gusad. E-abin dulluu imaksad, degine, degiteye-sogega ei-wagar usad. Sunmaksamargua, e-dordoneggi dogdemalad.

Agi, Moisés e-sakaga bela sogsad, igi Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-bendakega Faraón-imaksa, degine, igi Bab-Jehová Egipto-dulemar-imaksabali. Degine, igi igarba Israel-dulemar wiledani-gusmarbargua, Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemar-bendaksabali.
Jetro Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemargi e-sabgued-nue-oyosgusadba, degine, Egipto-dulemar-ganguedgi Israel-dulemar-bendaksagusadba, bela-bela weligwar-itosad.

Jetro sogded: “Bab-Jehová Faraónʼgi, degi, Egipto-dulemar-ganguedgi, bemar-bendaksad. Degine, bemar-Israel-dulemar Egipto-dulemar-be-wiodimaladgi, Bab-Jehová bemar-onosad. A-ular, Bab-Jehová-e-nug odummolesun.

”Deginbali, Faraón dulemar-baisursunnagwadiyob bemar-imaksabalid. Ar emigindi, Bab-Jehová Egipto-dulemar-sabsur-imaksadba nue an wissunnad, we-Bab-Jehová, baigan-bab-dummadye-sogmaladba bur-dummadid.”

Agi, Jetro ibdurgan-wargwen Bab-Dummadga-ogumakar-ukega susa gusad. Deginbali, Bab-Dummadga-ukbaliga, ibmar-baigan senonibalid. Geb a-sorbali, Aarón, degi, bela Israel-girmar-dummagan, Moisés-e-sakaba Bab-Dummad-asabin mas-gunnadmalad.
Moisés, dule-igar-nabomalad onugsasad
Banedgine, Moisés Israel-dulemarga igarmar-gwatirnanaid-nabogega signonikid. Ar ade, dulemar na gwatirismalale, Moisésʼse wakdaradba degi-iirmakmai osedoddaed.

Jetro dakargu, Moisés arbaed-dummad imake, Moisésʼga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be bela we-arbaed be imake? Emide, dulemar bese wakudaryalaba iirmakmai osedoddamalad. ¿Ar ibiga bebi walagwen we-dulemarga be igar naboge?
Moisés e-saka-abin sogded: —Ar ade, dulemar Bab-Dummadse igar-amimalaga anse nonidamalad.
Na-ebo gachimakarmalale, anse nonidamalad, dakega, doa bur-nabir soge. Geb an Bab-Dummad-igargan-mamaid ega an sogdaed, degine, igi-Bab-Dummad we-igargangi anmar-odurdakmai an ega sogdabalid.
Geb degine, e-saka-Jetro Moisésʼga binsaed ukded: —We-be-deyob-imakedi, nuedsulid.
Ar ade, be geggus daed, dulemar-bese nonidamarmogad geggus damarmogad. Be-arbaed-imakedi begi obined. Bebi-wargwen bela be imakosurguoed.
Binsaed-an-bega-ukoedi, nue be itogo. Bab-Dummad beba gudiguoed. Be-dulemar-anar Bab-Dummad-asabin be gwisguoed, bonigan-mamaid ega be sogoed.
Be-dulemar igar-mamaidgi be odurdako, degi, igar-mamaidba-imaked be odurdakbalo. Deginbali, ega be sogbalo, igi nanamalargebe, degi, ibumar imakmarbaloe.
Bedina, deyob be imakegala, neggweburgi dulemar-nabir-ibmar-imakmalad be suo:
”Wemala, dulemarga igar-nabodii gudoed. Igar-dummadile, bese senonikoed. Igar-bipigwardi, emar na nabomaloed. Weyobile, arbaed-dummad be imakosulid, ar wemala be-bendakmaloed.
Ar Bab-Dummad bega sogdibe, an bega-ibmar-sognaid be imakye, ar weyob be imakele, be unniguoed, degine, dulemarmoga, weligwaledgi na e-negse namarmogoed.”
Moisés e-saka-ega-soged itosad, a-sogedba bela imaksad.
A-ular, Moisés Israel-dulemar-bur-nabir-ibmar-imakmalad susad.
We-dulemar Israel-dulemarga igar-nabogedga degisadegu gudmalad. Igar-bur-dummagan Moisésʼse sesdamalad. Igar-burwiganadi, emar na igar nabodamalad.
Degi-neggusad-sorbali, Moisés e-sakaga sognai gualid, degimaloye. Degi, geb e-saka na e-negse gannar aligusad.
